MEMO TO: Board of [AUTHORITY]
RE: Taxable Revenue Bond and PILOT for [COMPANY] [PROJECT], [COUNTY]

Staff recommends approval of $12,000,000 in taxable revenue bonds and a 15-year PILOT for [COMPANY]'s [PROJECT], a $27,000,000 investment ($18,000,000 real property, $9,000,000 equipment) creating 150 full-time jobs at an average wage of $52,000, or $7,800,000 in annual payroll.

Debt: At 4.50% over 20 years with level monthly payments, debt service is about $75,918 per month, $911,017 per year, with total interest of about $6,220,344. Projected NOI of $1,500,000 yields a DSCR of 1.65x. Loan-to-value against total investment is 44.4%.

PILOT: Full annual tax on the real property is $205,200 ($18,000,000 x 40% x 28.5 mills); equipment is excluded. Years 1-5 are fully abated; abatement steps down 10 points per year from 90% in year 6 to 10% in year 14, with full taxes in year 15. The company pays $41,040 in year 7. Over 15 years, abated taxes total $1,949,400 (present value about $1,496,855 at 5%) and PILOT payments total $1,128,600. Abatement equals about $12,996 per job.

Note: LTV uses total capital investment ($27,000,000), including equipment, as the spec defines; against real property alone it would be 66.7%. Figures are rounded.
